description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver cafe chain founded in 1996, celebrated for small-batch organic coffee roasting and award-winning homemade New York-style cheesecakes. The Joyce-Collingwood location is one of 13–14 stores across Greater Vancouver, offering a full menu of sandwiches, baked goods, teas, and cold drinks alongside the signature cheesecake. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces) at 48m; stands (20 spaces) at 55m; stands (16 spaces) at 59m; stands (12 spaces) at 68m; stands (8 spaces) at 71m; stands (2 spaces) at 85m; stands (28 spaces) at 85m. Total: 98 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Trees Organic Coffee is an active, multi-location Vancouver cafe chain (founded 1996) with a Joyce-Collingwood location consistent with the OSM address. The website shows online ordering/pickup and a sandwich/baked goods menu confirming takeout; no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill was found on the site.
